assessment.cad_registration: Old rigid CAD-to-base transform is supported for the stored seam points against the new shell if registration_result=seam_compatible. The STL differs elsewhere; six functional-hole surface samples are absent, so hole/rim fit and physical interface require additional explicit verification before accepting a replacement skin.
assessment.features: New URDF defines no free root, actuators, active sensors or cameras. Camera and ToF are fixed visual/physical links. Legacy native MJCF free root, sensor and camera settings require an explicit migration decision.
assessment.native_baseline: Derivable by explicit conversion while preserving all 41 URDF link frames, fixed bodies, inertials and original STL collision geometry. Set fusestatic=false and verify compiled body tree/inertias; do not silently inherit old native MJCF dynamics.

cad_registration.hole_limit: Six stored anchors are hole reference positions, not surface points. Their nearest-surface distances cannot establish cone/rim fit; source analytic cone sample coordinates were not saved.

hole_local_existing_mesh_vertex_diagnost.interpretation: Uses existing mesh vertices in stored CAD crop and taper range; includes any adjacent surfaces. Diagnostic for changed local geometry, not analytic-cone registration.
